violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: (1) cut cantaloupe (44f) was stored in Pepsi 2-door display cooler (section B) overnight; (2) pooled eggs (65f) was stored in turbo-air 2-door prep cooler for 4.5 hours
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food items.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: - OBSERVED: food items at sushi station, grill station and in steam tables were not marked with 4 hour end point.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to follow TPHC agreement and mark 4 hour end point.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of @FOOD@. - OBSERVED: manufacturer containers of chicken essence were reused throughout the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to discard all reused chicken essence containers.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: a spray nozzle is connected downstream from the mop sink equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS shared the information of approved splitter with CFM. CFM will install an approved splitter in 3 days. GOLDEN BUFFET RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 08/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SALMON ON A SHELF ABOVE RAW BROCCOLI IN (2) WALK-IN COOLER (PRODUCE). OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE COOKED MUSSELS IN (1) WALK-IN COOLER (RAW FOODS).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: RAW SALMON AND RAW CHICKEN MOVED TO A LOWER SHELVES.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AT 125F (1HR) AND COOKED BEEF AT 95F (1HR) IN HOT HOLDING CABINET.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: CHICKEN AND BEEF TAKEN TO STOVE TO REHEAT TO 165F DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the THREE-VAT SINK with a concentration of 0ppm total chlorine. DISHWASHER PROVIDED THE BLEACH BOTTLE SHE HAD BEEN USING, AND IT WAS OBSERVED TO BE MAINLY WATER WITH A LITTLE BIT OF BLEACH.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. CDI: OPENED NEW BOTTLE OF BLEACH AND SHOWED DISHWASHER HOW TO CHECK THE CONCENTRATION OF SANITIZER SOLUTION BEFORE SHE SANITIZES.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: PLATES, METAL CONTAINERS THE HOT WATER SANITIZING DISHWASHING MACHINE WAS OBSERVED TO BE AT 142F AT THE BEGINNING OF THE INSPECTION AND PLATES WERE BEING RUN THROUGH IT. THE SANITIZING VAT OF THE THREE-VAT SINK HAD 0PPM BLEACH IN IT BECAUSE THE DISHWASHER WAS USING A BOTTLE OF BLEACH THAT WAS MAINLY WATER.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: DISHWASHING MACHINE TAKEN OUT OF USE. DISHWASHER STAFF RE-EDUCATED AND EHS MADE SANITIZING SOLUTION OF ~150PPM CHLORINE.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED. CLOTHS PLACED IN SANITIZER SOLUTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Observed hot water sanitizing dishwasher to be at 142F during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CDI: SERVICE CAME WITHIN AN HOUR OF INSPECTION AND ADJUSTED FINAL RINSE TEMPERATURE TO BE 160F.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED SOILED CARDBOARD LINING SHELVING.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CDI: PIC TOLD TO THROW CARDBOARD AWAY AND STOP USING IT TO AVOID CLEANING THE METAL SHELVING.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. Observed employee coats, purses, phones, and glasses stored on shelving with dry goods and open foods.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: items moved during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE BACK OF THE KITCHEN ACROSS FROM DOOR TO BE READING 80F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. HANDWASHING SINK MUST PROVIDE WATER WITH A TEMPERATURE OF AT LEAST 100F WATER. PLEASE REPAIR.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING INSIDE MIGALI 2-DOOR COOLER ACROSS FROM DEEP FRYERS: SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN 46F, GENERAL TSOS CHICKEN 46F, COOKED NOODLES 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: FOOD DISPOSED OF.

violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CDI: PIC CALLED MAINTENANCE DURING INSPECTION. DISHMACHINE IS NOW READING 161.7F.
